## Cite the original HOPE paper

The twelve-part audit examines version 1 of the following preprint:

> Mobahi, Hossein, and Peter L. Bartlett. *Hilbert Operator for Progressive
> Encoding (HOPE): A Mathematical Framework for Deconstructing Learned
> Representations in Deep Networks*. arXiv:2607.21366v1, 2026.

```bibtex
@misc{mobahi2026hope,
  author        = {Mobahi, Hossein and Bartlett, Peter L.},
  title         = {Hilbert Operator for Progressive Encoding ({HOPE}): A Mathematical Framework for Deconstructing Learned Representations in Deep Networks},
  year          = {2026},
  eprint        = {2607.21366},
  archivePrefix = {arXiv},
  primaryClass  = {cs.LG},
  url           = {https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.21366v1}
}
```

The versioned source used by this audit is
[arXiv:2607.21366v1](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.21366v1). If a later journal
version becomes the source you use, cite that version instead.
